instruction: I want to enable word wrap in the editor, please help modify the setting of VS Code.

metadata.explanation: Task requires modifying VS Code settings to enable word wrap in the editor. Evaluator uses existing check_json_settings metric to verify the setting is correctly applied in settings.json.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly fetches VS Code settings file from the standard location (/home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json)
Metric check_json_settings correctly loads JSON and verifies the specific key-value pair
Expected value 'editor.wordWrap': 'on' is semantically correct for VS Code word wrap setting
Evaluator provides complete coverage of the instruction requirement (enable word wrap)
Data flow is correct: file getter → JSON parser → key-value comparison
No postconfig needed as settings.json is persistent after modification
Logic will work correctly at runtime with proper error handling in the metric function

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json_settings first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
metric check_json_settings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
